units: metres; X east, Z south, Y up; origin = north-west corner of the 2048 x 1024 m grid; sea level Y = 0; Ebb lowers sea to Y = -6

bramblebridge_start_chimepost.note: village green, south bank; party spawn; checkpoint + card-loadout table

bramblebridge_stone_bridge.note: single arch over the Bramble; the corridor crosses it north

bramblebridge_watermill.note: undershot wheel on the mill race; wheel states: turning / stopped (Lv 5) / turning (Root-Sanctum cleared)

bramble_weir.note: feeds the mill race; choked by Elder Oak roots; Root-Sanctum exit

wrights_yard.note: cooper, bowyer, bark-tanner: Tier 1 wood kit

cold_smithy.note: forge unlit: no iron until the West Strait reopens

elder_oak.note: north bank of the Bramble above the weir; largest tree on the island

root_sanctum_entrance.note: Lv 6 capstone among the Elder Oak roots

seal_cove.note: corridor reaches sea level; Crown framed across open water

north_quay_pier_root.note: timber pier 30 m north into the bay; skiff bells

old_quay_platform.note: under water until world.ebb; then dry

mill_downs_windmill.note: island silhouette visible from the other isles

downs_gate.note: opens from the Hearthstead side only

west_strait_head.note: closed until Lv 6; causeway runs WNW to Iron-Ness

eel_spit_head.note: closed until Lv 6; shingle spit NE to Barrow-Eyot
